verdict.rationale: The official Angular CLI documents an `ng e2e` command that builds and serves the application, then runs end-to-end tests, so it ties e2e runs directly to the framework's dev server. The evidence does not say which e2e test runner is used, whether one is preconfigured in new projects, or how setup works. The only named tool, Protractor, appears in a dated AngularJS-era community comment. Missing for 10: identification of an official or bundled e2e framework, evidence it works out of the box without extra setup (e.g. via `ng add`), in-depth e2e guide docs, and current hands-on corroboration.
